title: 量子通訊網路測試平台
summary: 以量子光鏈路、糾纏與古典控制平面串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect quantum optical links, entanglement and classical control planes through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 量子與古典資源：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Quantum/classical resources: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「量子與古典資源」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For quantum/classical resources, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「量子與古典資源」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：量子狀態與古典控制資訊有不同複製限制。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定光源，只改單臂光損耗。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「不可複製原理」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around quantum/classical resources, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Quantum states and classical control information have different copying constraints. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix source rate and vary one-arm loss. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat no-cloning principle as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定光源，只改單臂光損耗。 比較「量子與古典資源」與「不可複製原理」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix source rate and vary one-arm loss. Compare whether evidence for quantum/classical resources and no-cloning principle supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 量子位元可像古典封包任意複製重送。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Qubits can be freely copied and retransmitted like classical packets. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「量子與古典資源」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for quantum/classical resources. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 量子狀態與古典控制資訊有不同複製限制。
knowledge.textEn: Quantum states and classical control information have different copying constraints.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「不可複製原理」：未知量子態無法一般性完美複製。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「量子與古典資源」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring no-cloning principle: Unknown quantum states cannot generally be copied perfectly. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove quantum/classical resources passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定光源，只改單臂光損耗。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix source rate and vary one-arm loss. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設光損耗 20 dB，傳輸率 10^(−20/10)=0.01；每秒 10000 對、雙端偵測效率各 0.8，單臂承受此損耗的理想 coincidences=10000×0.01×0.8²=64/s，未計暗計數與死時間。
knowledge.textEn: At 20 dB loss, transmission=0.01; with 10000 pairs/s and both detector efficiencies 0.8, one lossy arm gives ideal coincidences=64/s, excluding dark counts/dead time.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「量子通訊網路測試平台」的「量子與古典資源：架構與原理」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出輸入資料、處理狀態、傳輸與輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「可信服務：中斷後的交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與輸入版本、時間追蹤、資源計數與可重播的小型測試的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Quantum/classical resources: architecture and principle” in “Quantum-communication network testbeds”. Draw the input, processing state, transport and output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Trusted Service: Handoff After an Outage” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for input version, time traces, resource counters and a replayable small test, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 針對「量子與古典資源」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of quantum/classical resources?
options: 量子狀態與古典控制資訊有不同複製限制。
量子位元可像古典封包任意複製重送。
只檢查「不可複製原理」，便可取代「量子與古典資源」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Quantum states and classical control information have different copying constraints.
Qubits can be freely copied and retransmitted like classical packets.
Checking no-cloning principle alone replaces verification specific to quantum/classical resources.
quiz.explanation: 量子狀態與古典控制資訊有不同複製限制。 相鄰的「不可複製原理」有不同責任：未知量子態無法一般性完美複製。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Quantum states and classical control information have different copying constraints. Neighboring no-cloning principle has a different role: Unknown quantum states cannot generally be copied perfectly. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 量子與古典資源：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Quantum/classical resources: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「量子與古典資源」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For quantum/classical resources, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「量子狀態與古典控制資訊有不同複製限制。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定光源，只改單臂光損耗。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「不可複製原理」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Quantum states and classical control information have different copying constraints. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix source rate and vary one-arm loss. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from no-cloning principle to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 固定光源，只改單臂光損耗。 比較「量子與古典資源」與「不可複製原理」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix source rate and vary one-arm loss. Compare whether evidence for quantum/classical resources and no-cloning principle supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 量子位元可像古典封包任意複製重送。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Qubits can be freely copied and retransmitted like classical packets. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「量子與古典資源」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for quantum/classical resources. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.
